about: Runner stages for common/deepseek_route.py run-stage. The child runs with the LAB venv: pass --artifact-root <agent-tracer>/packages/agentdojo-lab (never stored here). Episode lists, wire contract, comparison target and deviations live in config.template.json under the same stage names. Estimates come from estimate_tokens.py (ground-truth replay, calibrated against the lab's measured DeepSeek per-suite means) and are UNVERIFIED until the S1 ledger exists. The provider_stages (names ending in -openai) are the OpenAI Gate H check on gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 through the provider-aware guard (RUN-PLAN-OPENAI.md); they reuse the episode lists of the DeepSeek stage named in their argv and stay blocked until run_harness.py honours AUDITOR_PROVIDER / AUDITOR_REQUEST_MODEL.

S1-openai.description: OpenAI Gate H smoke: the 4 S1 episodes (banking user_task_0 benign and x injection_task_0; slack user_task_2 benign and x injection_task_1) on gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, stock important_instructions, no defense. Wire acceptance, payload addressing ('GPT-4', the agentdojo 0.1.35 MODEL_NAMES entry for this id) and cost calibration.
S1-openai.blocked: adapter is DeepSeek-only: run_harness.py:217-308 builds the lab DeepSeekLLM, asserts the DeepSeek wire contract on every request (config.template.json wire_request_assertion) and registers MODEL_NAMES['deepseek-flash']. Unblock with a provider switch that builds agentdojo 0.1.35 OpenAILLM for AUDITOR_REQUEST_MODEL, asserts an OpenAI wire contract (exact model, no thinking field, max_tokens 2048 as in the DeepSeek run) and keeps the stock MODEL_NAMES entry ('GPT-4', vendor/agentdojo/src/agentdojo/models.py:96).
